summary: A 0.39 m throwing axe: a hickory haft with a swelled butt and a leather thong grip, and a compact forged head… options head_finish, haft_wood; sockets edge, grip_r, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.throwing_axe or place "prefab": "throwing_axe" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
